name: Surveyor 3
summary: Surveyor 3 was an unmanned robotic probe that dug the first trenches in lunar soil.
hook: I landed in 1967 in Oceanus Procellarum and was later visited by Apollo 12 astronauts.
how_it_worked: Used radar Doppler landing guidance, a surface soil scoop arm, and a television transmission system.
science: Proved the lunar soil could physically support the weight of heavy Apollo Lunar Modules.

facts.text: Apollo 12 landed within walking distance in 1969 and brought Surveyor 3 camera parts home to Earth.
Returned 6,315 television images during its first lunar day of surface operation.

image.alt: Surveyor 3 in its crater with the Apollo 12 Lunar Module on the horizon
